title: Residual function and protein fate of the missense and splice alleles

Variant classes: SDR missense (reference class), canonical splice acceptor, compound-heterozygous null-like (WOREE), missense (SCAR12), WW1 missense (P47T)
direction_status: Protein DOWN is observed for the reference-class missense in ONE non-neural system. UNCERTAIN: whether the limiting step is impaired synthesis or premature turnover (not measured), whether a stabilised protein is functional (stable-but-inert possible), and whether neurons behave like fibroblasts
desired_effect_and_motivation: Restore soluble, functional WWOX from the patient's own allele (broad, durable): the only question class whose success would restore the lost function itself rather than offset a consequence; the effect wanted is functional protein per cell, not abundance alone (IT6 P5: R = amount x function per molecule)
usable_information: 4 seed rows: Q230P protein down; Q230P transcript unchanged; c.517-2A>G exon-6 skipping (splicing outcome, direction uncertain); P47T partial-loss phenotype (state). reserved_for_evaluation: AAV9-WWOX dose-response and SWD (mouse null); organoid add-back at week 10; fly CRISPRa; the chloroquine/NH4Cl rescue pattern of P252A (route-pointing, another allele, cancer cells). falsifiers_or_irrelevance_conditions: (1) Q230P protein is present in neurons at functional levels (the absence is a fibroblast or sensitivity artefact). (2) The stabilised protein is inert, so abundance gain is not recovery. (3) The limiting step is transcript-level in neurons (transcript comparable is one bar without n). (4) The reference class is not representative: P282A is reported stable, P252A unstable (assignment unverified), so stability is allele-specific. (5) Protein amount alone predicts severity across allele classes (then residual function per molecule adds nothing)
conditional_hypothesis_if_protective_or_: OPTION A, degradation-limited (premature turnover of a made protein): candidates that lower clearance or raise folding of the existing protein (chaperone, degradation-route and proteostasis classes); prediction: soluble AND functional protein rises; a route blocker that raises only inactive protein is a failure
conditional_hypothesis_if_harmful_or_opt: OPTION B, synthesis-limited (impaired translation of the allele): turnover blockers are predicted NOT to work; candidates acting on translation or expression of the same allele; and OPTION C stable-but-inert: stabilisation is irrelevant and only function-restoring or replacement routes remain.
